questions.question: Which file defines the page at /products in the Next.js App Router?
questions.explanation: A page file defines the UI for its route segment. The products folder contributes /products to the URL.

questions.question: Which App Router path represents a page such as /products/42, where 42 is a route parameter?
questions.explanation: Square brackets define a dynamic route segment. In this example the segment is named id.

questions.question: An App Router page needs to read a private database credential and display a query result. Where should the database query run?

options.a: In a Server Component or a server-only data module it calls
options.b: In a Client Component's click handler
options.d: In a browser worker using a public environment variable

questions.explanation: Keeping data access on the server lets the UI receive the intended result without sending database credentials to the browser.

questions.question: A component imported directly by a Server Component needs useState and an onClick handler. Which directive marks its file as a client entry point?
questions.explanation: The use client directive marks the boundary for code that requires client-side React features.

questions.question: Which file conventions can customize what users see when an App Router segment is loading or encounters an uncaught error? Select all that apply.

options.b: middleware.tsx for a React error fallback
options.c: error.tsx for an error boundary fallback

questions.explanation: loading supplies a Suspense fallback and error supplies a client error boundary fallback for the segment's nested content.

questions.question: Which App Router file can export a GET function to implement /api/health?
questions.explanation: A route file defines an HTTP Route Handler through named exports such as GET or POST.

questions.question: Which App Router convention places a navigation bar around every page under /account?
questions.explanation: A layout wraps the UI of its segment and descendants using the children prop.

questions.question: Which import provides Next.js client-side navigation for a link to an internal route?
questions.explanation: The Link component from next/link extends anchor navigation with framework-aware client-side transitions.

questions.question: What is the URL for app/(shop)/products/page.tsx?
questions.explanation: A parenthesized folder is a route group for organizing routes and layouts. Its name is omitted from the URL.

questions.question: Which tasks belong on the server in a Next.js application? Select all that apply.

options.a: Read a secret payment service key
options.c: Handle a local slider's onChange event
options.d: Check a user's permission before changing a protected database record

questions.explanation: Secrets and authoritative access checks belong on the server. Browser viewport values and interaction handlers belong on the client.

questions.question: An App Router product page looks up a slug and finds no corresponding product. Which function can trigger the route's not-found UI?
questions.explanation: notFound ends rendering of the affected segment and selects the relevant not-found UI.

questions.question: A Server Component needs to generate a page title from the requested product. Which route export is intended for that?
questions.explanation: generateMetadata can use route data to return metadata such as the page title.

questions.question: Which hook can a Client Component import from next/navigation to read the current pathname without its query string?
questions.explanation: usePathname reads the pathname. useSearchParams reads the URL query parameters.

questions.question: Which export supplies known parameter values for static generation of an App Router dynamic segment?
questions.explanation: generateStaticParams returns parameter objects that Next.js can use to generate matching routes during the build.

questions.question: Which props can cross a Server Component to Client Component boundary in the forms shown? Select all that apply.

options.b: A plain object containing strings and numbers
options.c: A string containing a product name
options.d: An ordinary inline function with no Server Function designation

questions.explanation: Simple data such as strings and plain data objects can cross the boundary. Ordinary functions and live database connections cannot.

questions.question: A Next.js environment variable holds a secret API key. Which naming choice avoids the framework's explicit public-variable prefix?
questions.explanation: NEXT_PUBLIC_ marks values intended for browser bundles. The unprefixed secret should be accessed only in server-side code.

questions.question: Why might a developer use next/image for a product photo?

options.a: It gives all visitors permission to access the image source
options.b: It converts every image to an SVG
options.c: It can optimize image delivery and reserve layout space from known dimensions
options.d: It stores the image in a database automatically

questions.explanation: The Image component supports optimized responsive delivery and uses known dimensions to help avoid layout shifts.

questions.question: A Server Action accepts a form submission that updates an order. Where should authorization be checked?

options.a: Only when rendering the page that displays the form
options.b: Only in a client-side disabled attribute
options.c: Only after the database write completes
options.d: On the server as part of handling the action, before the write

questions.explanation: A mutation must verify permissions on the server even when the UI conditionally hides its form.

questions.question: A server-side mutation changes data used by a cached /products page. Which API explicitly targets that path for revalidation?
questions.explanation: revalidatePath invalidates cached data for the specified path. When it takes effect depends on where it is called.

questions.question: Which responsibilities can a Next.js Route Handler perform? Select all that apply.

options.c: Define a React layout around all pages in a segment
options.d: Receive and validate a webhook request

questions.explanation: A Route Handler processes HTTP requests and returns responses. Layout rendering and browser event handlers are separate responsibilities.
